profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with nearly a decade of experience designing and building scalable, data-driven, and high-performance systems across backend and frontend environments. I like to move fast, experiment a ton and take pride in UX. I believe great software is crafted not hacked together. I care deeply about performance, reliability, and most importantly, user experience. I refuse to trade performance or user experience for convenience. Passionate about building systems that feel fast, work reliably, and are a joy to use, restoring craftsmanship and technical excellence to modern software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Wrote and maintained IoT device drivers (cameras, intercoms, speakers) derived from reverse-engineered APIs across vendors, enabling support for thousands of devices in hospital networks.

* Developed real-time feedback system via WebSockets + MQTT to notify users when device commands (ping, reboot, volume, provisioning) completed—removing the need for manual refreshes and boosting task visibility.

* Accelerated data loading by ~92% (6 s → < 0.5 s) by enabling API pagination and optimizing Django queries.

* Fixed React dependency issues that caused redundant API calls, cutting network requests.

* Integrated Keycloak SSO, enabling authentication through Azure AD, Okta, Ping Identity, SecureAuth, and Google; authored internal and customer onboarding documentation.

* Migrated 4 CI/CD pipelines from GitLab CI to GitHub Actions using reusable Docker + AWS workflows, reducing build friction and deployment time.

* Collaborated on frontend performance profiling, Django API optimization, and AWS deployment improvements to increase system reliability.

Stack: Python (Django), React, TypeScript, Go, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, Keycloak, WebSockets, MQTT

projects.title: Deep Data Investing
projects.description:
● A research platform for stock market due diligence. Intended to consolidate the sea of data and help users identify potential investment opportunities.
● Built a dashboard to help users analyze public company’s intrinsic value by utilizing a model known as the Discounted Cash Flow valuation model.
● Created charts and other widgets to help visualize fundamental financial data such as cash flows, capital expenditure, capital structure, etc.
● Developed API to record user events such as page navigation, clicks, and inputs to better understand how users interact with the application and shift focus on what really matters to our users.
● Wrote a blog system backend and frontend to help bring attention to our application by posting informational investing articles.
